name: phantom-plugins
description: Plugins for Phantom IDEA, installed on demand instead of bundled

plugins.name: Phantom Database Console
plugins.description: Connect to MySQL, PostgreSQL or H2 over JDBC and run SQL from the editor: highlighting, Ctrl+Enter to run the statement at the caret, a sortable result grid and a lazily loaded schema tree. Drivers come from the project's dependencies or the local Gradle/Maven cache. Manual-commit data sources keep changes in an open transaction you review, commit or roll back in the Database Changes tool window. Edit single-table results in the grid, and compare two schemas with the SQL to make them match. SQL in @Query(nativeQuery = true), @NativeQuery and JdbcTemplate/JdbcClient strings is highlighted and completed. Query history (Ctrl+Alt+E), result export to CSV, TSV, JSON, SQL INSERT or Markdown, and JPA entity generation from a table. 0.5.0: SQL that understands names (alias-aware completion with schema loaded on demand, Ctrl+B to the table or column, unknown table/column warnings, Reformat), a table data view with WHERE/ORDER BY filters, paging and foreign-key navigation, keys/foreign keys/indexes/routines/triggers in the tree, Show DDL and Modify Table, manual-commit transactions, Explain Plan/Analyze and query parameters.

plugins.name: Phantom Spring
plugins.description: Spring support for Java and Kotlin: bean injection navigation in both directions, an autowiring inspection, correct unused analysis for Spring-managed code, Spring MVC handlers for the Endpoints tool window, Spring Security path and expression support, and Kafka/RabbitMQ/JMS sender-receiver navigation.

plugins.name: Phantom Spring Boot
plugins.description: Spring Boot support: File → New → Project → Spring Boot generates projects with Spring Initializr, and application*.yml / application*.properties get completion and quick documentation for keys and values, from library metadata and the project's own @ConfigurationProperties, in Java and Kotlin. An Actuator tab beside the console of a running app (health, beans, mappings, environment, polled only while shown; only for modules with spring-boot-starter-actuator), and completion and Ctrl+B for ${...} placeholders in @Value from the project's application.yml/properties and Spring Boot metadata.

plugins.name: Phantom JPA
plugins.description: JPA, Hibernate and Spring Data JPA for Java and Kotlin: JPQL in @Query with completion and errors, derived query method checks, a @Modifying check, entity mapping checks, and repository/entity gutter navigation. An Entity Diagram tool window: entities, columns and relations drawn from the code, copyable as a Mermaid erDiagram.

plugins.name: Phantom Reactive Streams
plugins.description: Reactor and RxJava checks for Java and Kotlin: a Mono, Flux or RxJava source created and dropped without being subscribed, and blocking calls inside reactive operators.

plugins.name: Phantom Ktor
plugins.description: Ktor server routes from the routing DSL, including routes in Route extension functions with the prefixes of their callers, in the Endpoints tool window.

plugins.name: Phantom Kubernetes
plugins.description: Helm chart templates: .Values completion and navigation from values.yaml, .Release/.Chart fields, include/define navigation, and a warning for values that values.yaml does not define.

plugins.name: Phantom Profiler
plugins.description: CPU and allocation profiling for Java and Kotlin with Java Flight Recorder: a Profile action next to Run and Debug, a Profiler tool window that records any running JVM, and a .jfr viewer with flame graph, call tree, hot methods, allocations and GC summary. Profile also works on Gradle run configurations: tests run by Gradle and applications delegated to Gradle, one recording per forked JVM.

plugins.name: Phantom Docker
plugins.description: Docker Compose through the docker CLI: run icons on compose services, a Docker Compose run configuration shown in Services, and a Docker tool window listing containers by compose project with start, stop, restart, remove, logs and compose down. Polls only while open.

plugins.name: Phantom Redis
plugins.description: A Redis browser and console: keys by SCAN pattern, values of every type with JSON indented, delete, and a redis-cli style command line with history. Password, ACL user, database and TLS. Connects only while the Redis tool window is shown.

plugins.name: Phantom Kafka
plugins.description: A Kafka browser: topics with partitions and offsets, latest/earliest/since-time messages read without joining a group, sending with key, headers and partition, consumer group lag, create and delete topics. SASL/SSL via client properties in the password safe.
